fills.researcher_notes: MEED, published 16 June 1995: 'Production at the Kadanwari gas field began at the end of May, the operator Lasmo Oil Pakistan... has announced. The gas will be processed on site by Lasmo and sold to Sui Southern Gas Company. It will be transported via a dedicated 400-kilometre pipeline to Karachi.' This is a dedicated single-purpose line matching this row's name/route/owner (SSGC), and 400 km is within map-digitizing tolerance of the sheet's 412.0 km. Verdict: field first production and the dedicated pipeline's start-up are effectively the same event here (article is contemporaneous, describing a purpose-built line, not a tie-in to a pre-existing trunk), so StartYear1=1995 is supported, but tier is medium because it is one source and the pipeline clause is forward-looking ('will be transported') rather than a confirmed-complete statement. UNVERIFIED SECONDARY LEAD (not cited as a ref — cannot pass url_verifier, Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' JS challenge on every UA tried including Googlebot spoof): DuckDuckGo's own cached snippets of two thefreelibrary.com articles (trade-press reprints, likely Oil & Gas Journal / Pipeline & Gas Journal) independently give near-identical specs — 'Natural gas industry of Pakistan' (thefreelibrary.com/Natural+gas+industry+of+Pakistan.-a019137736): 'The transmission line comprising of 134 km of 24 inch diameter and 264 km of 20 inch diameter pipelines, has been completed during 1993-95' (134+264=398 km, matching this row's 24/20-inch diameter spec); 'Sui Southern Gas Company Limited' (thefreelibrary.com/Sui+Southern+Gas+Company+Limited.-a013886606): '20 inch and 24 inch diameter pipeline spanning 408 kilometer to link Kadanwari field.' Both cite a 1993-95 completion window consistent with 1995. A human with institutional/library database access (Gale, ProQuest) could likely pull the original trade-journal text and turn this into a high-tier, independently-verified corroboration.

validity.recommendation: No action needed on spec — flag as strong corroboration for the record. This row's diameter (24, 20), LengthKnown (412.0 km) and Capacity (180.0 MMcf/d) match SSGC's own official network table EXACTLY under the internal name 'KDN Pipeline (Kadanwari-Malir-Karachi)'. This is the text-searchable SSGC asset register the protocol asked us to flag loudly if found: SSGC 'Gas Transmission' page, https://www.ssgc.com.pk/web/?page_id=5597 ('Gas Transmission Capacities Utilization as on June 30, 2018' table) — verified OK/200, contains '412', 'Bajara' and 'FJFC'. It also independently names the other two rows in this brief (P4016, P4020) with exact matching specs. It carries no per-segment commissioning dates, so it does not resolve the Date_logic flag on any of the three rows, but it is the single most useful document found in this leg and is worth surfacing for every row in the ssgc-sindh cluster and any adjacent Pakistan-gas cluster researching SSGC-owned rows.
